name: tradysquid-maintainer
description: Private Codex/Claude coordination, repository maintenance, tests, learning review, and controlled Git publication for Tradysquid.

tools.name: coordination_status
tools.description: Read the shared state, active lock, and Claude handoff.

tools.name: begin_update
tools.description: Acquire Claude's exclusive shared update lock.

tools.name: finish_update
tools.description: Record a completed Claude update and release the lock.

tools.name: repo_status
tools.description: Inspect Git branch, commit, status, and recent history.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a safe text file inside the repository.

tools.name: search_repo
tools.description: Search repository text without exposing secrets.

tools.name: replace_text
tools.description: Replace exact repository text while Claude owns the lock.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Create a repository text file while Claude owns the lock.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run Tradysquid syntax checks and unit tests.

tools.name: publish_update
tools.description: Commit explicit files and push normally to GitHub main.
